messages:
leo_sales: Quick heads-up 11 Greenline Health is leaning towards a reserved commit but legal flagged our sizing assumptions. Need a short ops + pricing checklist to align before the term sheet.

anika_sre: Can you paste the presales traffic assumptions? rps, avg tokens, model?

leo_sales: They modeled 45 rps peak, 28 rps steady. Avg tokens per call ~140 (prompt+resp). Model: redwood-gpt-3.2-q (quantized). They asked for a 99.9% availability target and 95th p50 latency goal ~ <500ms.

sam_infra: Token rate peak = 45*140 = 6300 tps -> ~544.32M tokens/day if sustained. That is inconsistent with a 10M/month commit. Need to confirm whether commit is monthly or burst-credit bucket.

meera_fin: Confirmed commit line says "10M tokens/month, initial term". Thats smaller than peak run-rate by order of magnitude. We should propose two tiers in the contract: (1) conservative reserve matching 95% steady; (2) reserve+burst plan for peak with burst credits.

ram_prod: For customers that want predictable latency we recommend reserved GPU pool sized for 95th steady and explicit burst policy to hosted-burst. Also call out KV-cache warmup impact for multi-turn chat.

anika_sre: Ops ask list: KMS BYOK? VPC/private endpoints? Audit logs export? Pen test/SOC2? And expected lead time for key integration.

sam_infra: BYOK yes for Private and Dedicated (we integrate via customer KMS policy). Private needs key policy + 48-72h integration window with security. For hosted dedicated we can do cross-account CMK but need a short questionnaire. Add that to the deliverables.

leo_sales: Customer specifically asked: "If we reserve X GPUs, will you autoscale within our pool or spill to hosted?"

anika_sre: Default: autoscale within reserved pool up to max_replicas. When reserved exhausted, route to hosted-burst if enabled, or fall back to smaller model. Recommend explicit routing policy in MSA.

sam_infra: I'll produce a sizing matrix for quantized 3.2B on A100 and H100 for rps -> GPUs and token throughput. Include preheat costs: we recommend a 4-6h preheat window for good KV warmup for typical chat diversities.

anika_sre: Autoscale proposal (sample):

```yaml
autoscaling:
  min_replicas: 1
  target_latency_ms: 450
  scale_threshold_qps_increase: 12%
  scale_step: +1
  cooldown_s: 45
  max_replicas_reserved: 10
  burst_pool: hosted-burst
```

ram_prod: Routing fallback example to include in runbook: quantized-2B -> hosted-burst -> degrade to cached response for low-priority traffic. Also list expected latency bands per tier.

meera_fin: For pricing Ill draft two worked examples: (A) 95th steady reserve sized for 28 rps; (B) full reserve sized to 45 rps with burst credit consumption scenarios. Include token overage pricing and GPU-hour burst credit pricing.

leo_sales: Operational checklist for contract:
- Confirm monthly vs peak numbers with customer
- NDA/traffic scrub for 24h sample
- Sizing sim on staging at 80% peak
- KV-warmup sim (need sample prefixes)
- KMS integration window and policy docs
- Billing annex for burst credits and overage

anika_sre: Who owns the smoke test? I can run the KV-warmup and staging smoke if infra reserves a slot. Need 2h at 80% peak + 6h preheat if possible.

sam_infra: I can allocate a staging slot and run perf sims. Will post a small table with GPU counts, expected latency p50/p95, and token capacity. Will include both A100 and H100 curves.

deploy-bot: scheduled "greenline-preheat-smoke" for 2026-04-02T08:00:00Z. Participants: @sam_infra, @anika_sre.

meera_fin: Also need to note contractual fallback SLAs: e.g., if we spill to hosted-burst, hosted latency SLO may be reduced; well show expected delta. Legal wants this explicit in the risk appendix.

ram_prod: Ill prepare a one-page runbook: sizing matrix, autoscale YAML, routing fallback JSON snippet, KV warmup guidance, security quick answers. Send draft by tomorrow EOD.

leo_sales: Timeline: customer to confirm commit semantics today. Sam to post perf sims in 48h. Meera to circulate pricing scenarios Monday. Anika to own smoke/KV tests. Ram to draft runbook. Thanks all :thumbsup:

anika_sre: noted. Post any logs or sims into this thread. If we get the traffic sample, we can finalize reserve recommendation.

leo_sales: pinging @greenline-sec to send the data sample after NDA.
